title: Freeze the baseline and fix data gaps
hypothesis: Current medians are a valid benchmark for the next 3 weeks.
intervention: Start daily metric snapshots (monitoring) for posts and follower count; log every post's format and topic at publish time.
decision_rule: Proceed when 24h/72h snapshots exist for every new post.

title: Space authored posts (max 2/day, >= 6h apart)
hypothesis: Same-day stacking is associated with lower reach for later posts (author-diversity mechanism).
intervention: Cap authored posts at 2 per day, >= 6h apart; extra items become replies/threads or move to the next day.
control: Previous 4 weeks of the same account (pre/post) and the stacking days in history
primary_metric: median views relative to trailing baseline
decision_rule: Keep spacing if median vs-baseline of posts that would have been 3rd+ rises above 0.8x without lowering weekly total views by > 10%.

title: Article-anchored week vs mixed week
hypothesis: X Articles (with a native preview post) outperform other formats on matched topics.
intervention: Alternate weeks: anchor week = 2-3 X Articles on core topics + supporting posts; control week = usual mix.
decision_rule: Adopt as default if anchor-week median >= 1.3x control-week median in both alternating pairs.

title: Outcome-first hooks vs current openers
hypothesis: Openings that state a concrete outcome or how-to promise earn more expands/dwell than observational openers.
intervention: Randomise (coin flip per post) between an outcome/how-to hook and the author's natural opener for non-article posts.
decision_rule: Adopt if treatment median vs-baseline exceeds control by >= 1.3x with both arms >= 8 posts.

title: Specific closing prompt + first-hour author replies
hypothesis: Ending with a specific, answerable question and replying to early commenters raises replies per 1k views.
intervention: Half of posts (randomised) end with a specific question; author replies to the first 5 comments within 60 minutes.
secondary_metrics: ['views vs baseline', 'share of posts with >= 5 replies']
decision_rule: Adopt if replies per 1k views is >= 1.3x control with no drop in views vs baseline.

title: Expert-addition comments on larger in-niche accounts
hypothesis: 2-3 sentence expert additions on in-niche posts earn more views and reply-backs than generic replies.
intervention: 10 comments/day: substantive additions on posts < 60 min old from accounts with 2-20x the client's followers in core topics; stop emoji/one-word replies.
control: The account's previous 4 weeks of conversational comments
secondary_metrics: ['share of comments that receive a reply', "new accounts engaging with the client's posts"]
decision_rule: Continue if median views per comment >= 2x the previous median and reply-back share rises.

title: Lead-magnet delivery without mass identical replies
hypothesis: Delivering lead magnets via DM/pinned reply instead of hundreds of identical public 'Sent' replies keeps conversions and removes a duplicate-reply risk.
intervention: For half of lead-magnet posts (alternating), deliver via one pinned reply + DM automation; vary wording.
control: Alternating lead-magnet posts with the current 'Sent' replies
secondary_metrics: ['views vs baseline of the lead-magnet post', 'DMs delivered']
decision_rule: Switch if comments per post are within 15% of control.

title: Evaluate, keep or drop
intervention: Re-run the full audit pipeline; compare each experiment's primary metric against its decision rule.
decision_rule: Retain experiments that met their rule; extend underpowered ones rather than calling them.
